messages:
Maya Patel: quick update — I kicked off a 5% canary for v2p1-int8 on /chat this morning. baseline vs canary shadow A/B looks okay so far but want to flag a cross-slice entropy uptick on long-form prompts.
Jon Rivera: can you paste the slices where entropy moved? rough numbers are fine.
Maya Patel: yes — short summary: overall coherence score delta +0.6% (good), but the long-form slice (>=512 tokens, creative prompts) shows perplexity down but response entropy +3.1% and a small hallucination rate bump from 0.9% -> 1.6%.
Kevin Zhou: @Maya thanks. 3.1% entropy delta on long tails is notable. what's the traffic split? any latency or token cost improvements?
Maya Patel: traffic 5% uniform; latency tail p95 +12ms, mean token cost -5% (due to int8).
Irene Castillo: what's our auto-fallback config? do we have a delta threshold that would trigger immediate rollback or gradual drain?
Jon Rivera: current canary policy (prod) checks: objective metrics every 30m, require: quality delta (safety-regression) < 1.0% absolute, hallucination delta < 0.5% absolute, entropy delta < 2.0% on any monitored slice. if any single slice breaches, we pause and alert.
Maya Patel: cross-slice entropy breach is at 3.1% so per policy we should pause.
canary-bot: ACTION — canary v2p1-int8 @ 5% paused at 3298765432 by policy: slice long-form.entropy > 2.0%.
SRE Ops Bot: Notifying #eng-oncall and paging oncall@redwood for manual review.
Kevin Zhou: thanks bot. quick thought: could this be a sampling fluke? how many eval samples in the long-form slice?
Maya Patel: sample count 420 in that interval (>=512 tokens). bootstrap CI on entropy delta ~ +/-0.6%, so 3.1% is ~5 sigma. not a fluke.
Jon Rivera: ok we should follow the runbook: 1) pause traffic (done), 2) run targeted A/B with shadow logging on the affected slice at 0% live but 100% shadow, 3) run evals with the aligned prompt set and include feature flags for KV-cache/no-cache.
Irene Castillo: also run a quick compare versus v2p1-fp16 (hosted baseline) to see if int8 quantization introduced distribution shift. collect: token-level entropy, hallucination classifier score, and rouge/bleu-ish similarity for factual prompts.
Maya Patel: doing that now. will start the shadow run and post a short artifact with results. attaching planned config: ```
{
  "canary": {
    "traffic_percent": 5,
    "monitor_interval": 1800,
    "slices": ["short","mid","long-form"],
    "auto_fallback": {
      "entropy_delta_abs_pct": 2.0,
      "hallucination_abs_pct": 0.5,
      "quality_abs_pct": 1.0
    }
  }
}
```
Kevin Zhou: looks good. add a temporary lower threshold for long-form entropy to 1.5% for this experiment so we get earlier signal next run.
Maya Patel: done — updating canary policy for the shadow run.
Jon Rivera: once we have the shadow logs, run the regression eval harness (prompt suite: regressions_longform_v3) and post the top 20 failure cases to the ticket. if it's quantization-specific we should test int8+kvcache-disabled and int8+kvcache-enabled to isolate.
Maya Patel: will do both. estimated 45m to finish shadow run and initial evals.
Irene Castillo: ping me when results land. if it's a true degradation we should mark this roll as blocked for promotion and annotate model registry with reason e.g., "entropy-increase-longform-int8" and suggested mitigations (tune quant params or keep int8 but adjust compilation kernels).
Maya Patel: agreed — plan B if persistent: revert to v2p1-fp16 for long-form routing and keep int8 for short/mid slices, plus follow-up tuning.
canary-bot: NOTE — please attach the regression eval artifact ID to the canary ticket for automated analysis.
Maya Patel: attaching results now: quick takeaways — shadow A/B confirms entropy up ~3.0% on long-form, hallucination classifier up 0.7% (breach), qualitative review shows occasional tokenization anomalies on prompted code blocks.
Kevin Zhou: tokenization anomalies could be quantization + kernel selection artifact. let's spin a micro-benchmark: int8 kernels with sequence len 1024 on same hardware, run n=100 prompts from failing set.
Jon Rivera: I'll queue the micro-bench and link results. in parallel we should open a model-registry patch that tags v2p1-int8 as "blocked: long-form entropy" and create a canary issue for next attempt with adjusted compiler flags.
Irene Castillo: good. also create a short customer-facing note draft in case we need to explain a temporary route pin to support.
Maya Patel: will do all of the above. thanks team :thumbsup:
Kevin Zhou: thanks — boil it down to owners/action list in the ticket and let's reconvene in 60m.
Maya Patel: will update ticket with owners: @Maya (lead), @Kevin (bench), @Jon (eval), @Irene (ops comm).
